questions.stem: What is the first step when expanding $(x + 1)(x + 2)(x + 3)$?

options.text: Multiply $x$ from each bracket to get $x^3$ and stop
Expand any two of the brackets first, then multiply the result by the third
Multiply all three brackets at once

questions.explanation: To expand triple brackets, first expand any two brackets to get a quadratic, then multiply every term in that quadratic by every term in the remaining bracket.
